audience: affiliate marketers and vendors who track offers, clicks and conversions in Affilink

useCases.title: Review the offers visible to your account
useCases.text: Read offers visible to your organization or vendor. Webhook secrets are removed from the results.

useCases.title: Check click reports for your key's scope
useCases.text: Read click reports within your API key's scope. Reports are not pooled across accounts.

useCases.title: Compare conversions with clicks
useCases.text: Read click and conversion reports within your API key's scope, then compare the two.

useCases.title: Read conversion reports for your scope
useCases.text: Read conversion reports within your API key's scope to review the conversions recorded there.
